value.name: Asha calls psychiatric admissions
value.description: Asha places a call to psychiatric admissions using the extension Rosa texted her.
evidence: extension for psychiatric admissions that Rosa had sent her two texts ago.

value.name: Claire waits tensely at the table
value.description: Claire sits frozen and anxious, physically bracing herself for what will be said on the call.
evidence: Claire's hands had come apart in her lap; one of them was resting flat on the table now, fingers spread, as if she were trying to feel through the wood for whatever was about to be said into the phone.

value.name: Asha positions herself between Claire and the stairwell
value.description: Asha stands up and places her body between Claire and the stairwell, anticipating trouble from upstairs.
evidence: Asha pressed the call through and stood, partly to be moving when the line picked up and partly to put her body between the stairwell and the kitchen
because the quiet upstairs had shifted half a tone in the last minute

value.name: Asha listens for movement upstairs
value.description: Asha keeps her attention on the stairwell, sensing that something may be happening upstairs before Claire notices it.
evidence: the quiet upstairs had shifted half a tone in the last minute, the way a house does just before a child sits up in bed.
she would hear a doorknob before Claire did

value.name: Asha steadies Claire with her hand
value.description: While waiting on the call, Asha rests her hand on Claire's chair as a silent reassurance.
evidence: she set her free hand on the back of Claire's chair without looking down at her
the small steady weight of it standing in for the sentence she did not yet have time to say

value.name: Call connects to hold tone
value.description: The phone connects and immediately goes to hold, delaying the admissions conversation.
evidence: The line clicked over to a hold tone

value.name: Asha gives diversion case number
value.description: When the admissions clerk returns, Asha quietly reads out the diversion case-tracking number from her legal pad.
evidence: When the admissions clerk came back on, she spoke low into the receiver and read off the diversion case-tracking number from the legal pad without looking down at it

value.name: Rosa texts urgent instruction
value.description: Rosa sends Asha a new text telling her the call has been answered and to push for the transfer date immediately.
evidence: the screen lighting against her jaw with Rosa's name: a single line telling her the ring had answered, to push for the transfer date now, no gaps.

value.name: Asha continues speaking despite the text
value.description: Asha notices Rosa's urgent message but keeps reciting the number without interrupting the call.
evidence: Asha registered it without breaking off the number she was reciting

value.name: Claire notices the second message
value.description: Claire watches Asha and realizes there is another text message arriving on the phone.
evidence: Claire, watching from the other side of the table, saw the second messag
